primaryReference.differences: New validation-only implementation, no IDCT/pixel output/coefficient magnitudes. Do not preserve upstream tolerant decoding, missing-block skips, unchecked trailing entropy or unchecked marker/array access.

algorithm: Parse bounded8-bit Huffman SOF0/SOF1/SOF2,DHT,DRI,SOS; canonical Huffman tables with bounded symbols/lengths and exact segment bounds. Arithmetic/lossless/hierarchical or unsupported precision fail explicit422, never unchecked acceptance.

Derive interleaved MCU and noninterleaved component-block counts from dimensions/sampling, including padded edge blocks; consume every required block. Respect restart interval and cyclic RST0..7, discard only legal all-one byte-alignment padding, reset scan-local EOB/refinement state at valid restart boundaries.

Baseline consumes DC category/difference bits and AC run/size/ZRL/EOB with exact coefficient bounds. Progressive DC first/refine consumes correct symbols/bits. Progressive AC first/refine uses persistent nonzero-presence bitsets indexed by block and spectral coefficient; consume refinement bits only for already-nonzero coefficients and mark newly nonzero coefficients. Track spectral successive-approximation sequence without coefficient magnitudes or IDCT.

Reject entropy exhaustion/marker during a required code or value; invalid Huffman path; invalid categories/runs; restart ordering/count; unexpected trailing entropy; EOB overrun and incomplete refinement state. Require all supported scan structures to finish truthfully; retain full external/native pixel decode after this check.

bounds.operationFuel: 200,000,000 operations, primary deterministic bound; async yield at <=1,000,000 operations plus at most one bounded MCU; every loop advances input/block/coefficient state or fails. 1ms cooperative timer yields allow request abort/wall deadlines to run.
